title: docs: MCP_SERVER.md complete_task currentBranch note and moe-qa-loop SKILL.md step 3 describe shared-mode landing only
description:
Filed by WT-19's whole-epic adversarial review (task-b1ca54f2716442be889a14623eb59983, step 7).

PROBLEM. Two doc passages still describe only shared-mode landing.
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md, the complete_task currentBranch note. It says the wrapper lands "on the branch its safe-branch step picks (a literal consolidationBranch doubles as that peel target; otherwise moe/work-<YYYY-MM-DD>)". In worktree mode that is wrong:
  - the worker reports moe/task/<taskId>;
  - the completion is a merge-tree squash onto the target (a literal consolidationBranch, else main);
  - no safe-branch step runs.
- docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md step 3. It says "`git branch --contains <sha>` confirms it is on the shared branch". In worktree mode the completion SHA is on the target.

EVIDENCE. Checked on merged tree 88e507e5 (moe/work-2026-10-24 at 1558f141 plus the WT-19 task).
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md:587. The correct worktree bullet sits two lines up, at :585.
- docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md:26.
- The wrapper side: scripts/moe-agent.sh:7726, "Never peel_target_branch, ensure_safe_branch or the shared push".

IMPACT. Since WT-19's gate-aware default, a project with a qualityGate runs in worktree mode. A QA seat or an integrator following these lines checks the wrong branch. It may reject a correctly landed task, or chase a moe/work-<date> branch that never moves.

FIX DIRECTION. Add a worktree-mode clause to both passages, naming the target (a literal consolidationBranch, else main) and the branch (moe/task/<taskId>). Rebuild the daemon in a snapshot so prebuild re-vendors the skill. The same kind of doc drift is already filed as task-347dde8560ac467aaa9c02a1d1532b74, and one session can take both.
definitionOfDone: docs/MCP_SERVER.md's complete_task currentBranch note states the worktree-mode branch (moe/task/<taskId>) and landing target (literal consolidationBranch, else main), and keeps the shared-mode text for shared mode.
docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md step 3 says where the completion lands in each mode; the daemon's vendored skill copy is regenerated by prebuild and npm run lint passes.
